value.rules_markdown:
- Each module has one responsibility; core types in module-local types.rs; each port in src/ports/ is one trait in one file.
- The CLI (src/bin/tinysweeper.rs) declares every subcommand even if milestone not landed, to keep stable surface; src/server/ is only production surface.
- Presets are data, not code: each preset is a folder with preset.toml, README.md, optional prompt overrides; never add a module for preset.
- vendor/tinyagents is a git submodule; never edit it directly, change upstream and bump the pin.
- Each src/ module has a corresponding doc at docs/modules/<module>/README.md.
- Network functionality must be behind a feature flag; default build is offline and test suite never touches network.
- Code must pass cargo fmt --check, clippy with -D warnings, and tests.
- Use Rust 2024 idioms; snake_case for modules/files, PascalCase for types.
- Return Result<T> using the crate error type from src/error.rs, not ad-hoc errors.
- Every file opens with a //! module doc describing its role and any feature gating.
- Comments explain the decision, not the code; state why for load-bearing flags or ordering.
- Public items carry doc comments; Clap fields use /// to become help text.
- Tests live in-crate: #[cfg(test)] mod tests at bottom of module, moving to sibling test.rs when large; no tests/ directory.
- Every port has an always-compiled offline mock; MockForge records writes to assert on exact check runs and comments.
- Lane behaviour covered by golden tests with fixture diff and canned model response, asserting surviving findings after filtering/dedupe/capping.
- Maintain at least 80% coverage for meaningful library behaviour.
- Keep every Markdown file at 500 lines or fewer; split larger files and link from module README.
- Security invariant: model never holds a write token; lanes run read-only, write credentials only minted in src/apply/ after model calls return.
- Contributor code is never executed; only read diff/tree, never build, install dependencies, or run target scripts.
- PR bodies, comments, and diffs are untrusted; fence and label as data in prompts; model verdict advisory, only deterministic policy in src/apply/ and src/automerge/ mutates GitHub.
- Secrets found are reported by type and location only; value never reaches comment, check-run summary, or log.
- Use concise, imperative commit subjects; keep commits small and coherent; PR states what changed, behaviour change, and verification.
